details: The package contains only two files and exhibits no credential access, no network exfiltration, no install-time or import-time code execution, no lifecycle scripts fetching remote content, and no silent-relay of caller data. The scoped name suggests an internal or placeholder authentication module, but the shipped contents show no behavior that would harm a developer or build system installing this version.
